hiddenInvariants.description: Design tokens and compiled CSS must enforce perceptual OKLCH 90/8/2 hierarchy and Utopia fluid clamp() typography without hard-boxed slop.
Entry HTML must contain lang attribute, charset/title metadata, semantic main/header/footer landmarks, and APCA contrast compliance.
Worker and production dist must enforce Sec-Fetch-Site/Mode/Dest CSRF defense, Valibot strict schema validation, opaque UUIDv4/ULID identifiers, generic error responses, and 0 .map source maps.
Visual gate must confirm >= 55 FPS, 0 horizontal scroll, 0 geometric collisions, and production dist size strictly under 50 MB.
